scientific.integrity: The dimension counts follow from explicit restriction splittings of the published resolution of the reflexive hull, together with the published two-component classification of the degree-two quotient moduli. No numerical experiment or inaccessible source is used as a proof premise.
limitations: Only the two generic quotient strata are determined; no complete irreducible decomposition of the boundary locus is claimed.
Incidence degenerations where the hull singular point meets the quotient support are not classified.
The skew-line family is not claimed to be an irreducible component of the full boundary locus.

title: Two generic quotient strata in the multiplicity-two boundary locus
